'''Rumen Stoyanov Ovtcharov''' ({{langx|bg|Румен Стоянов Овчаров}}) (born 5 July 1952) is a [[Bulgaria]]n politician, [[engineer]], [[physicist]], and [[economist]]. He was a member of the [[National Assembly of Bulgaria|National Parliament]] on four occasions and was the [[Ministry of Economy, Energy and Tourism (Bulgaria)|Minister of the Economy and Energy]] between 17 August 2005 and 18 July 2007.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://personi.dir.bg/person.php?id=173|title=Профил на Румен Овчаров|access-date=2014-06-30|publisher=personi.dir.bg|language=bg}}</ref>

== Biography ==

Ovtcharov served as the Minister of Energy and Energy Resources in the [[Zhan Videnov]] government between June 1996 and February 1997.{{sfn|Lilov|2013|p=130}}

Ovtcharov is married to Ivanka and they have three children - Yana, Theodora and Slav.{{sfn|Lilov|2013|pp=128–129}} In addition to his native [[Bulgarian language|Bulgarian]], he is fluent in [[Russian language|Russian]] and [[English language|English]].{{sfn|Lilov|2013|p=129}}

As of February 12, 2021 Rumen Ovcharov is under court proceedings for the ownerless and a loss of government finances of 500 million leva in connection with the Belene nuclear power plant.<ref>https://www.24chasa.bg/novini/article/9511471 2021</ref>

== U.S. Treasury sanctions ==
The [[Office of Foreign Assets Control]] of the [[United States Department of the Treasury]] has placed Ovcharov under sanctions pursuant to the [[Global Magnistsky Act]] for alleged participation in "corrupt energy contracts with Russian energy companies, receiving bribes and other kickbacks in exchange for fixed-price contracts for Russian gas and nuclear fuel and support contracts at [<nowiki/>[[Kozloduy Nuclear Power Plant]]]. Ovcharov has received more than five million euros in offshore bank accounts since serving as Minister of Energy."<ref>{{Cite web |title=Treasury Sanctions Corrupt Elites Across Bulgarian Political Spectrum |url=https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy1264 |access-date=2023-02-10 |website=U.S. Department of the Treasury |language=en}}</ref>
